notes.title: Hunting and Weapons
notes.notes:
[h3]Welcome to the new update!
This is about hunting new animals on additional 2 new islands with new weapons.
Use the bow or other firearm to kill the animals both on land and in the air.
On  [i]"Costa De Porky"[/i]  you will only find peaceful pigs.
Now it's getting dangerous, because on  [i]"La Isla Boscosa"[/i]  you will also find wolves and bears, so be careful.
[/h3]



[h2][olist]
[*]  Costa De Porky (new island)
[*]  La Isla Boscosa (new island)
[*]  Firearm
[*]  new animals
[*]  Animals can now be gutted with a knife (further loot)
[*]  Mushrooms and herbs can be cut off with a knife
[*]  additionally new trees and terrain textures
[/olist][/h2]
